_comment: Canonical platform asset dimensions. Source of truth for all campaign asset generators.

x.note: Hashtags hurt reach above 3 on X

instagram.note: First comment or caption; Reels benefit from more

facebook.note: Hashtags have minimal reach effect on FB

substack.note: Appended at end; discoverability and SEO

reddit.note: No hashtags. Subreddits serve same function.

platform_notes.linkedin: External links in FIRST COMMENT only — never in post body. Algorithm penalizes body links.
platform_notes.x: External link in reply after final tweet, not in tweet body, to maximize reach.
platform_notes.instagram: NO clickable links in captions. Bio link is only funnel. Update bio before posting.
platform_notes.facebook: Links in post body are OK on Facebook — no algorithm penalty like LinkedIn.
platform_notes.reddit: Link in comment (post body gets auto-suppressed in many subreddits). Engineering-log tone.
